title: The house
content: I’m not sure if I’m even in the right space, but here it goes anyway. I have had a recurring dream about the same house since I was a child. I know I’ve never seen this house or been to this house in this timeline, but it has been with me my whole life. The surroundings around the house change. Sometimes it’s in the woods, sometimes it’s on a beach, other times in other locations. I can’t pinpoint any specific location either. Just that it’s changed through the years. I don’t get bad feelings from the house. But it’s old. I always feel both enchanted and vividly aware of the history of it. It’s a big house, but I can’t quite describe the architecture of it. It doesn’t fit a specific mold. At times I think it’s the same, but different depending on ME, at different stages of my life. I know this house intimately, but I don’t. I feel like I will stumble upon it though. And I’m always looking.
